sar.reason: R9: Undocumented coordinated fraud pattern identified
sar.narrative: During the period from 2016-11-17 to 2016-11-17, suspicious unauthorized card transactions totaling $599.94 were identified on card C03042-K1 belonging to customer C03042. The activity exhibited characteristics consistent with undocumented. Investigation of the associated transaction network revealed connections to device profile Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050 and additional accounts ['C11227-K1', 'C05704-K1', 'C01155-K1', 'C05292-K1', 'C00681-K1', 'C11413-K1', 'C02881-K1']. The cardholder confirmed that they did not authorize the charges and maintained possession of their card. The sequence and Velocity of transactions demonstrate an organized attempt to exploit compromised account credentials. The bank has declined all pending charges, blocked card C03042-K1 for reissue, and placed connected accounts under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: Defensible decision reached with corroborating evidence and verification; card protected and SAR generated.
